title: Flamurtari win Kategoria I-re Meshkuj 2022/23 season
description: Flamurtari have won the Kategoria I-re Meshkuj 2022/23 season finishing with an 11-1 record on top. In the last game Flamurtari overcame Skenderbeu 61-49. Eraldo Kollovi (197-C-1998) top-scored for the winners with 16 points and Marsel Sotiri (1993) netted 12. Armelind Sotiri (2001) produced 11, whilst Marko Miranovic (190-G-1990) nailed 10. Bruno Topi (G-1991) replied with 22 points in the losing effort.
